name: Bret Harrison
bio: Bret Michael Harrison (born April 6, 1982) is an American actor and singer known predominantly for his work on comedy-dramas such as Reaper and The Loop. He also was a co-star in the show Grounded for Life, that ran for five years. He also played Dr. Sidney Miller on ABC's V and Cameron Price on Fox's Breaking In.
